<style>{`
  /* ─── Hide page chrome ─── */
  nav[aria-label="breadcrumb"],
  [class*="breadcrumb"],
  [class*="Breadcrumb"],
  [data-testid="breadcrumb"],
  [class*="page-feedback"],
  [class*="pageFeedback"],
  [data-testid*="feedback"],
  [class*="page-nav"],
  [class*="pageNav"],
  [class*="next-prev"] {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* ─── Hero — Mintlify style centered ─── */
  .cap-hero {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 3rem 1rem 2.5rem;
  }
  .cap-hero h1 {
    font-size: 2.6rem !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em !important;
    line-height: 1.15 !important;
    color: var(--text-primary, #111827) !important;
    margin-bottom: 0.6rem !important;
  }
  .cap-hero-sub {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    color: var(--text-secondary, #6b7280);
    max-width: 520px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    line-height: 1.65;
  }

  /* ─── Product cards — image top, text below ─── */
  .cap-cards .dai-card {
    background: var(--card-bg, #fff);
    border: 1px solid var(--card-border, #e5e8f0);
    border-radius: var(--card-radius, 14px);
    box-shadow: var(--card-shadow, 0 1px 3px rgba(19,65,169,0.04));
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: box-shadow 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease;
  }
  .cap-cards .dai-card:hover {
    box-shadow: var(--card-shadow-hover, 0 8px 24px rgba(19,65,169,0.10));
    border-color: var(--card-border-hover, #c7cee0);
  }
  .cap-cards .dai-card-image {
    aspect-ratio: 3 / 2;
    object-fit: cover;
    width: 100%;
    border-radius: var(--card-img-radius, 13px 13px 0 0);
    display: block;
  }
  .cap-cards .dai-card-body {
    padding: 1rem 1.15rem 1.15rem;
  }
  .cap-cards .dai-card-title {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    font-weight: 650;
    color: var(--text-primary, #111827);
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }
  .cap-cards .dai-card-description {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: var(--text-secondary, #6b7280);
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .cap-cards .dai-card-cta,
  .cap-cards .dai-card-icon {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* ─── Divider ─── */
  .cap-divider {
    border: none;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--divider, #e5e7eb);
    margin: 2.5rem 0;
  }

  /* ─── Section heading ─── */
  .cap-section h2 {
    font-size: 1.3rem !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em !important;
    color: var(--text-primary, #111827) !important;
    margin-top: 0 !important;
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem !important;
    border: none !important;
  }
  .cap-desc {
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    color: var(--text-secondary, #6b7280);
    line-height: 1.55;
    margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  }

  /* ─── Migration cards — use global horizontal card tokens ─── */
  .cap-migration .dai-card-horizontal {
    background: var(--card-bg, #fff);
    border: 1px solid var(--card-border, #e5e8f0);
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: var(--card-shadow, 0 1px 3px rgba(19,65,169,0.04));
    transition: box-shadow 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease;
  }
  .cap-migration .dai-card-horizontal:hover {
    box-shadow: var(--card-shadow-hover, 0 8px 24px rgba(19,65,169,0.10));
    border-color: var(--card-border-hover, #c7cee0);
  }
  .cap-migration .dai-card-horizontal .dai-card-icon {
    background: var(--brand-light, #eef2fb);
    color: var(--brand, #1341A9);
    border-radius: 10px;
  }
`}</style>
